trap.target: SEG1 Flat-rate freelancers without an app

items.quote: It is the largest segment with the highest interest: 1.06M freelancers and 23% purchase intent at 9 euros per month, against 6% to 11% in the other three segments.
The document puts the market at 3.4M freelancers with a VAT number, of which 1.9M are in the flat-rate regime [3].
44% of flat-rate freelancers use an invoicing app, and the average price paid is 7.20 euros per month [3].
Official data show a steady inflow of new flat-rate registrations: 242,529 in 2025, or 48.5% of new VAT numbers and up 3.9% on 2024 [4].
Fatture in Cloud is the leader. Its Forfettari plan costs 4 euros per month in year 1 and 8 euros per month after that [5, 6].
Aruba and Fattura24 start at 1 and 4 euros per month [8].
Some competitors, such as ForfettApp and Fiscozen, already cover F24 payments [9, 10], and Fakturo does not yet [11].
Among the document's customer groups, flat-rate freelancers without an app show the highest purchase intent at 9 euros per month (23%) [12].
The Fakturo beta had 68% of users still active after 3 months and a 4.4/5 rating [11].

Fatture in Cloud (TeamSystem) | Market leader with broad invoicing features for small businesses and professionals. E-invoicing is included (sending, receiving, signing, storage), with a 30-day free trial. The Forfettari plan is aimed at flat-rate freelancers but is limited to 100 documents per year. The document says plans run from 4 to 30 euros per month; web sources list plans up to 51 euros.

Qonto | Business bank account that bundles e-invoicing. The Starter plan is free for eligible professionals and sole traders. Paid professional plans start at 9 euros per month + VAT, billed annually.
Understand how much tax they will owe: 58% of flat-rate freelancers without an app say they do not understand it [12]
Pay tax instalments by F24 from the same app: 41% of Fakturo beta users asked for this [11]
Prices around the market average of 7.20 euros per month [3]

Lead with the annual plan at 90 euros, which is 7.50 euros per month, close to the market average.

Flat-rate freelancers without an app mostly use it or ask their accountant.
Fakturo's live estimate answers that need. Because they often ask their accountant, accountant referrals and professional associations are the right channels.

strategy_vs_analysis.reason: The target SEG1 is chosen because the analysis compares all four segments by size and purchase intent (about 244k vs 76k, 90k, 99k intent-weighted), and the positioning, pricing (keep 9 euros, lead with annual plan, no undercut) and channels (associations, accountants, search, social, onboarding) each follow from stated customer needs and competitor findings. Goals are checked against SEG1 size, and risks such as F24 and unverified sources are explicitly handled.

campaign_vs_strategy.reason: Every channel message speaks to flat-rate freelancers without an app, centres on the tax estimate updating with each invoice and SdI sending, and uses only the strategy's channels (associations, accountant referrals, search/SEO, Instagram/LinkedIn, onboarding emails). No message claims F24 payment, and the 30-day trial and 9 euro/90 euro pricing match the strategy.
